scientific_alternatives_decision_matrix.decision_context: Stage 3B-R2 empirical simulations proved that the proposed dual Newey-West HAC + Stationary Block Bootstrap test exhibits severe size distortion in small samples (rejection rate 7.70% - 10.80% at the null boundary vs nominal 5.0%). Consequently, a confirmatory superiority evaluation cannot be certified with the existing test specification.

OPTION_A.title: Retain Existing HAC + Stationary Bootstrap Rule for Confirmatory Inference
OPTION_A.description: Proceed with the preregistered dual-gate test (require both HAC and Stationary Block Bootstrap to reject at p < 0.05 against the 10-bps economic hurdle).
OPTION_A.scientific_rationale: The joint rule fails to control Type I error in small samples (N=30). Empirical null-boundary rejection is 7.70% to 10.80% (95% CI: [6.20%, 9.52%]), violating nominal size control. Claiming confirmatory statistical rigor under an oversized test is scientifically invalid.

OPTION_B.title: Develop and Independently Calibrate a New Confirmatory Inferential Protocol
OPTION_B.description: Investigate alternative statistical methodologies (e.g. wild bootstrap, studentized block bootstrap, Bartlett-corrected HAC, pre-whitened kernels) to restore nominal 5% size control at N=30.
OPTION_B.scientific_rationale: Developing, tuning, and calibrating a new statistical test requires substantial offline econometric research. To prevent data-snooping and confirmation bias, any new candidate procedure must be fully specified, simulated, and peer-reviewed in advance without exploiting prospective market data or holdout observations.

OPTION_C.title: Prepare an Exploratory Prospective Observational Comparison of Frozen E0 and D2
OPTION_C.description: Collect prospective market observations under frozen E0 and D2 execution rules and evaluate performance purely as an exploratory, descriptive observational study without claiming confirmatory statistical superiority.
OPTION_C.scientific_rationale: Allows prospective observational evidence to be gathered cleanly and losslessly under frozen strategy contracts. Avoids false claims of confirmatory statistical significance while preserving full operational transparency and descriptive uncertainty metrics.

scientific_alternatives_decision_matrix.owner_action_required: Review the alternatives and formally endorse Option C (Exploratory Prospective Comparison) as the scientific governance baseline.
